title: Very Cute but cannot use washer or dryer to clean
text: Very Cute but cannot use washer or dryer to clean. I would expect a hand towel, even a cute cat novelty hand towel to be machine wash and dry.  Particularly since I want to get germs out of it.  This one must be hand washed in lukewarm water and dried in the shade.  It only gets three stars because it is cute.  Knowing the care instructions I will not acquire more.
